lines.text: بمفاسد زحل با راس دلالت کند بر سقوط عظما از منازل و هلاك وحوش و در بیت عاشر
lines.en: to the corruptions of Saturn with the Head, it indicates the fall of the great from their stations and the destruction of wild beasts, and in the tenth house

lines.text: دلالت کند بر قوت ملوك و عامه (احکام بودن مشتری مع راس) دلالت کند بر بسیاری
lines.en: it indicates the strength of kings and the common people. (Judgments of Jupiter being with the Head) It indicates the abundance of

lines.text: خیرات و طاعات و قوت اهل ادیان و ارباب ناموس و رفعت اهل شرع و فقها و علما و ارباب
lines.en: charities and obediences, and the strength of the people of religions and the masters of honor, and the elevation of the people of the law, and jurists, and scholars, and the masters of

lines.text: فتوی و راستی دارالقضا و رونق مساجد و مدارس و میل مردم بسفر و حج و عتبات عالیات
lines.en: fatwas, and the rectitude of the house of judgment, and the flourishing of mosques and schools, and the inclination of people to travel, and pilgrimage, and the holy thresholds,

lines.text: و زیارات مزارات و اماکن متبرکه و مواضع شریفه و بسیاری عبادات و اجابت دعاها و
lines.en: and visits to shrines and blessed places and noble sites, and the abundance of acts of worship, and the answering of prayers, and

lines.text: توجه خلایق بایثار زکوة و صدقات و وقوع امانت و دیانت و صلح در میان مردم و فراخی
lines.en: the attention of the creatures to the giving of zakat and alms, and the occurrence of trustworthiness and piety and peace among the people, and the spaciousness

lines.text: و ایمنی و ارزانی و خوشی معیشت خلایق و بسیاری نفوذ خاصه در جانب خراسان و اقلیم
lines.en: and safety and cheapness and the pleasantness of the livelihood of the creatures, and the abundance of influence, especially in the direction of Khorasan and the clime

lines.text: دوم (احکام بودن مریخ مع راس) دلالت کند بر خوشدلی سلاطین و امرا و قوت حال
lines.en: of the second. (Judgments of Mars being with the Head) It indicates the cheerfulness of sultans and emirs, and the strength of the condition

lines.text: ارباب سلاح و اقبال دزدان و عیاران و انصاف ایشان در ان امر و رواج کار صناعان
lines.en: of the masters of weapons, and the good fortune of thieves and rogues, and their fairness in that matter, and the currency of the work of artisans

lines.text: و اتشکاران و توبه و انابت فساق و مفسدا و بدکاران و اهل شر و ارباب خیانت و ظهور
lines.en: and fire-workers, and the repentance and turning back of the wicked and the corrupt and the evildoers and the people of evil and the masters of treachery, and the appearance

lines.text: پارسایان بی عمل و مردم رزاق اکثر ترکان صحرانشین و رونق کار لشکریان و خوشی معاملات
lines.en: of the pious without action, and the people of sustenance, mostly the desert-dwelling Turks, and the flourishing of the work of the soldiers, and the pleasantness of the transactions

lines.text: ایشان با مردم و صحت بیماران و امد و رفت عساکر از اطراف و جوانب و اجتماع اهل سپاه
lines.en: of them with the people, and the health of the sick, and the coming and going of armies from the sides and directions, and the gathering of the people of the army,

lines.text: خاصه در اقلیم سیم و رغبت مردم بکارها خیر و بزرگی کردن فرو مایگان و سفلگان و ظهور
lines.en: especially in the third clime, and the inclination of the people to good deeds, and the greatness of the lowly and the base, and the appearance

lines.text: مردم خودستای و رزاق و قوت حال قصابان و سلاخان و شبانان و فرونشستن فتنه
lines.en: of boastful and sustaining people, and the strength of the condition of butchers and slaughterers and shepherds, and the subsiding of sedition.

lines.text: و اهل احکام گویند که چون مریخ در ثلث عاشر بود و صاعد در افلاك دلايل فتنه قائم شده
lines.en: And the people of judgments say that when Mars is in the tenth third and ascending in the spheres, the indications of sedition are established,

lines.text: باشد بودن او مع راس دلیل شهرت حرب بود و اگر دلیل فتنه و حرب قائم نشده باشد
lines.en: its being with the Head is an indication of the fame of war, and if the indication of sedition and war is not established,

lines.text: دلالت کند بر قوة حال ملوك و عامه (احکام بودن شمس مع راس) دلالت کند بر ارسال
lines.en: it indicates the strength of the condition of kings and the common people. (Judgments of the Sun being with the Head) It indicates the sending

lines.text: رسل و رسایل میانه پادشاهان و سلاطین و گفتگوی مصالحه از جانبین و امدن اخبار
lines.en: of messengers and messages between kings and sultans, and the discussion of reconciliation from both sides, and the coming of news

lines.text: ساره از جانب عظماء و امرا و شادی فرماندها و عدل و انصاف ملوك و حکام و اقبال
lines.en: of joy from the side of the great and the emirs, and the happiness of the commanders, and the justice and fairness of kings and rulers, and the good fortune

lines.text: بندگان و خدمتکاران و بسیاری زر و سیم و بیرون امدن جواهر نفیسه از معادن و افزونی
lines.en: of servants and attendants, and the abundance of gold and silver, and the coming out of precious jewels from the mines, and the increase

lines.text: ممالك و خزائن ملوك و سلاطین و میل بزرگان بخیرات و صدقات و زیادتی عز و جاه مهتران
lines.en: of the kingdoms and treasuries of kings and sultans, and the inclination of the great to charities and alms, and the increase of the glory and dignity of the chiefs,

lines.text: و تندرستی خلایق در اقلیم چهارم اینست انچه جمهور در احکام شمس مع راس در کتب ایراد
lines.en: and the health of the creatures in the fourth clime. This is what the majority have brought forward in the books regarding the judgments of the Sun with the Head,

lines.text: کرده اند و انچه معلم اول در این باب فرموده خلاف جمهور است لیکن چون سخن این قسم
lines.en: and what the First Teacher has said in this chapter is contrary to the majority, but since the speech of this section

summary.headline: Planetary Judgments with the Head
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun conjoined with the Head, covering effects on kings, peoples, religions, warfare, trade, health, wealth, pilgrimage, and regional conditions in Khorasan and specified climes. The page notes a disagreement between the majority of authorities and the First Teacher concerning the Sun with the Head.
